properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Saturday, December 2, [1933]; includes description of the continued aftermath of the accident at Zhoushan Island [aircraft registration number NC16V] and its potential effect on the contract in China mediated by the minister of communications [Chu Chia-Hua]; mentions [William] Grooch, George Rumrill, [William L.] Bond, and Max Polin.
